text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, as we 
passed by a park...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh! The children are building a castle. 
That's quite a splendid piece of work!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Stay back! This is our sandbox!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: Damn right! I won't let anyone slack off!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Come on. Why don't you calm down a bit?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Playing together is fine and all. But 
kicking someone out just 'cause they're 
not part of your group isn't right, don't 
you think?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Acting all high and mighty! You 
can't build a bigger castle than ours 
anyway! If you can, maybe I'll listen to 
what you have to say!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You want to challenge me... with a 
castle?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Okay! I'll take you up on that!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The match began to see who could build
the 
bigger castle within the time limit!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
...Heave-ho. The base is almost done! 
How's your side?

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
Looking good over here too! Let's start 
dishing it up soon!

text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to get lost in 
thought, I stopped. No, that can't be it—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Don't think! Just have fun!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Your shoulders are way too tense. Just 
enjoy the darts... that's all there is to 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Right, no need to overthink things. No 
matter the situation or the opponent,
have 
fun first. That's what matters!”

!! ...Hell yeah, that's what I'm talkin' 
about! Let the seas carry us to glory!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about theory! Let's build a 
castle in a way no one else could ever 
copy!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's get covered in sand 
right away! We can always just wash our 
clothes later!
choice_data_list: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Haha! Sorry! My hand slipped!"
choice_data_list: Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, now we can fool around as much as 
we want! C'mon, c'mon, let's make it huge!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Except! I'm making the top!
I'll make it a 
design that stands out even from far away!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What did you say? There's no way in hell 
I'm giving this up!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I'll make it first!! Raaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two built a sandcastle 
together, sometimes goofing around and 
sometimes completely serious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Time was up. Comparing the finished 
castles, the children's was superior in 
size. However...

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Hey. I can see foreign countries out 
there. ...Never been to one, though.

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
I can see someone dancing in a really 
flashy way. ...Even though I've never met 
them before.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you took a liking to our 
castle! Pretty exciting, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah…… Our castle is bigger, but…… I'll 
call it a tie!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You see? Playing with the others is fun 
too, isn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
